decisions.reason: As an outpatient service close to the core mental-health support offer and upgraded from a website mention in 2023 to the home page in 2024, it has visible strategic backing and management is likely to persist with it.
This counseling service fits the firm’s eldercare direction and its presence on the home page in both 2023 and 2024 signals a strong public commitment that makes withdrawal unlikely.

Although somewhat more peripheral than direct care services, the retail shop builds on sheltered-workshop capabilities and its move onto the home page in 2024 suggests rising commitment, so management would probably continue it.

The meal delivery service is new and only mentioned on the website, so it has less accumulated commitment than the others, but it still fits the senior-support portfolio of an expanding firm and is likely to be given more time.
